variants.briefing:
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists are dedicated to keeping the delicate ecosystems of the empire in balance. A client recently hired us to evaluate the environmental impact of a number of invasive creatures near [Location]. We’ve determined that to preserve the natural order of the region a conscientious culling of these species is necessary.  

Looking for someone able and willing to help in this effort. Please refer to "The Guide to Stanton Wildlife" in your Journal for further information on the creatures being targeted.     

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

variants.briefing:
Native plants and animals near [Location] are on the verge of environmental collapse due to the dramatic population spikes of several invasive species. We’ve been contracted to dramatically reduce the current population of these species to help avoid an environmental collapse. We need a dedicated and highly skilled exterminator to carry out this contract.     

You can better acquaint yourself with the creatures in question by referencing "The Guide to Stanton Wildlife" in your Journal.     

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
